name: week
title: Ecological survey review
subtitle: Internal snapshot. Fictional data until you import your own records.

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select * from review_queue order by review_due,code

sections.title: Evidence and permission checks
sections.sql: select code,rule,finding from record_checks order by code,rule

sections.title: Field follow-ups
sections.sql: select * from actions_due order by due_on,code

name: species
title: Species and survey effort
subtitle: Internal evidence summary. Counts are observations, not population estimates.

sections.title: Species register
sections.sql: select * from species_register order by project,scientific_name

sections.title: Effort
sections.sql: select project,method,count(*)::int surveys,sum(effort_minutes)::int effort_minutes from survey_register group by project,method order by project,method
